title: British Rail Announcement
description: Broadcast their local time using the British Rail time format.
body:
## TimeAnnounce (Fabric)

**TimeAnnounce** is a lightweight utility mod designed to bridge the gap between real-world time and your in-game immersion. Perfect for multiplayer servers or players who easily lose track of time during long gaming sessions, this mod seamlessly formats and announces real-world times directly to players.

Using a hybrid architecture, the mod handles timezone configurations and scheduling on the server side, while utilizing the client side to trigger local accessibility features.

---

### 💡 Features

* **Real-World Timekeeping:** Never miss an appointment or stay up too late mining again. Get periodic updates of the actual time according to your preferred timezone.
* **British Rail Formatting:** Includes a dedicated text formatter (`BritishRailFormatter`) to display or announce times in a clean, traditional, and easily readable format.
* **Narrator Integration:** Fully compatible with Minecraft’s built-in Text-to-Speech (TTS) narrator. The mod sends custom packets to individual clients, allowing the game to literally speak the time to you without cluttering your chat log.
* **Per-Player Customization:** * Save your personal timezone so announcements match your local clock.
* Easily toggle the audio narrator announcements on or off using intuitive in-game commands.



---

### 🛠️ Installation & Architecture

To experience the full functionality of TimeAnnounce, **the mod should be installed on both the Server and the Client.**

* **Server-Side:** Manages player timezone storage, processes configuration commands, and dispatches sync packets when it's time for an announcement.
* **Client-Side:** Listens for announcement packets, processes local player toggle configurations, and hooks into the Minecraft audio narrator to speak the time.
